lifecycle.note: vet402 counts each purchase row once, in one lifecycle stage or one outside box. vet402 never drops a row from the total when a correction moves settled to another status. lifecycle.stages.settled holds only the rows of l1.settled whose paid request answered 202 Accepted, answered HTTP 2xx with a body vet402 recorded as empty, or has no HTTP status on record.

stageDefinitions.http_402: vet402 got HTTP 402 from the seller and stopped before signing, or vet402's budget or halt gate stopped signing after the 402.
stageDefinitions.signed: vet402 signed a paid request. vet402 has not settled it on chain yet, or settlement failed, or the seller returned goods without a receipt.
stageDefinitions.settle_claimed: vet402 recorded a seller asserted settlement receipt. vet402 has not confirmed it on chain yet, or vet402 re-read the chain and the receipt did not match.
stageDefinitions.settled: vet402 re-read the payment on the chain. The paid request answered 202 Accepted, or HTTP 2xx with a body vet402 recorded as empty, or vet402 has no HTTP status on record, so vet402 does not call it delivered or not_delivered.
stageDefinitions.delivered: vet402 re-read the payment on the chain and the paid request returned HTTP 2xx other than 202 Accepted with a body vet402 did not record as empty.
stageDefinitions.inconclusive: vet402 holds the row because the paid HTTP response was 4xx, or vet402's payer wallet was unfunded in a recorded window. vet402 keeps the row public in its own stage, apart from delivered and not_delivered.
stageDefinitions.not_delivered: vet402 re-read the payment on the chain. The paid request returned 5xx, or another HTTP status outside 2xx that vet402 does not leave in settled. vet402 counts HTTP 4xx as inconclusive. vet402 leaves 202 Accepted, HTTP 2xx with a body vet402 recorded as empty, and no HTTP status on record in settled. This stage does not say whose side the failure is on. See Whose side.
stageDefinitions.revoked: vet402 recorded a chain re-read correction that moved this purchase out of settled. The row stays in the ledger with its new status.
stageDefinitions.no_402: vet402's first request did not return HTTP 402.
stageDefinitions.unknown: vet402 has not matched this row to a named stage rule yet.

catalogSourcesNotRead.name: x402scan resources
catalogSourcesNotRead.note: Each read of this list costs USD 0.01 over x402. vet402 does not pay for catalog reads.

publicApiUsage.note: Call counts per UTC day from client_usage_daily, for calls made without an API key. Rows from vet402's own monitors and observatory clients are left out. decision counts GET /api/v1/resources/{id}/decision. check counts GET /api/v1/check, a separate entry point, so it is not part of decision. sdk counts every route called by a client that names itself vet402-sdk/<semver>, and those calls are not counted again under decision or check. mcp counts rows whose client is vet402-mcp/<semver>. mcp:* routes from any other client are counted in otherRoutes. Current SDK and MCP releases may not send that User-Agent and then appear as other. These counts are not added to l1.attempts.

sellerEdgeOverhead.statement: vet402 has 0 seller edge overhead samples. The minimum to publish a p95 is 20. vet402 does not claim the 20 ms target.
sellerEdgeOverhead.about: vet402 publishes the overhead the seller edge adds around the seller handler. vet402 prints the measured p95 in statement. vet402 does not claim the target when fewer than 20 samples exist. When the measured p95 is above the target, vet402 publishes that value and does not claim the target.

coverage7dDefinition: Endpoints whose catalog record is active and that have an L0 check in the last 7 days, divided by endpoints whose catalog record is active. Operator endpoints and endpoints with source seller_retest_request or vet402_evm_lane are left out of both counts. This is the same definition as the 22.4% read on 2026-11-08.
disclaimer: Aggregate L0/L1 measurements over the public x402 discovery catalog. Catalog source: the CDP x402 Bazaar, the Circle x402 discovery, and the MPP directory (and equivalent public discovery surfaces). Discovery surfaces vet402 does not read are outside the measured population. A chain can also appear here with a small count because only part of its listings reach this catalog. Absence or a small count is a coverage limit, not a finding. Facts with denominators, not an assessment of any operator. 'unverified' means vet402 has no grounds to publish pass or fail yet, most often because the endpoint has not been probed. It does not mean dead. publishedPass counts endpoints on record whose latest L0 probe passed, including delisted endpoints, so it can exceed activeEndpoints. publishedPassActive is the part on active records, and publishedPassActiveProbeOlderThan7d is the part of that whose latest probe is more than 7 days old (a pass stands until the next probe). l1.endpointsSettled counts endpoints (active or not) with at least one settled row and is the sum of l1.endpointsSettledSellerReceipt (at least one settled row whose transaction the seller named in its settlement receipt, settlement_source=seller_claim) and l1.endpointsSettledIndexOnly (the seller returned no receipt, and every settled row's transaction was found by vet402's own settlements index, settlement_source=vet402_index, or named in a Circle Gateway batch, settlement_source=circle_gateway). l1.settled is the transfer vet402 re-read on-chain. l1.settledCircleGateway counts settled rows in a Circle Gateway batch, with no separate transfer to the payee. l1.delivered is a settled attempt whose paid request also answered HTTP 2xx other than 202 Accepted, with a non-empty body. l1.inconclusive counts paid attempts held rather than counted against the seller, split in l1.inconclusiveByReason: settled4xx (the payment settled and the paid request answered 4xx), unsettled4xx (the paid request answered a 4xx other than 402 and no settlement receipt came back, including sellers that validate a request before settling it, since 2026-09-17) and payerUnfunded (a 402 or 5xx during 2026-09-13T00:00Z to 2026-09-15T23:49Z, when vet402's own Base payer wallet had run out of USDC, since 2026-09-17). vet402 cannot always form the request a seller expects (no API key of the seller's, and a POST body only when the seller declares one), so a 4xx cannot be separated from a request vet402 itself formed wrongly, the same principle the methodology already applied to path_template URLs, extended to the body and the authentication header. l1.inconclusiveSettled is the settled part of l1.inconclusive and is out of the denominator for delivered. Settled minus delivered minus inconclusiveSettled counts settled rows that are not delivered and not inconclusive (5xx, 202 Accepted, an empty 2xx body, or no HTTP status on record), not a 4xx vet402 could have malformed. l1.settled is published at two evidence strengths whose counts sum to it. The settlement asset is USDC on Base, Arc, Celo, Solana, Stellar, Arbitrum One and Avalanche C-Chain, USDC.e on Tempo, RLUSD from its fixed issuer on XRPL, and USD1 on BNB Chain. l1.settledNonceBound re-read the one-time value stored for that purchase (the EIP-3009 authorization nonce on Base, Arc, Celo, Arbitrum One, Avalanche C-Chain and BNB Chain, a memo vet402 wrote on Solana, the indexed memo of a TIP-20 TransferWithMemo on Tempo, the hash of the signed blob on XRPL), so that transaction is the one for that purchase. Stellar is not in this count. The Stellar re-read checks payer, payee, amount and asset. l1.settledAmountPayeeOnly matched payer, payee, amount and asset and did not bind a one-time value. That tier holds rows that settled before the nonce binding shipped at 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z, and it holds Stellar rows. Rows in that tier are not demoted. vet402 does not refute a seller on evidence it does not hold. Read the weaker tier as a weaker claim, not as a finding about the seller. l1.settledTimeWindowOk counts settled rows whose settlement block time falls within -5/+15 minutes of the attempt. l1.settledTimeWindowUnknown counts settled rows with no block time on record. l1.settledLateLinked counts settled rows whose transaction the seller did not name: the paid response carried no settlement receipt, and vet402's own settlements index found the transfer afterwards (payer, payee, exact amount, time window) before the same on-chain re-read. It is a different axis from the two evidence strengths and is not part of their sum. The ledger export marks those rows settlement_source=vet402_index. l1.byChain covers every chain an L1 attempt ran on and sums to the l1 totals. Top-level totals include testnets. The top-level byChain is L0 and mainnet-only (byChainScope): it counts only network ids vet402 knows to be mainnets, byChainTestnetEndpoints counts the known testnets left out, and byChainUnclassified lists, verbatim with their counts, the network ids vet402 cannot name as either (left out of byChain rather than assumed to be mainnets), so sum(byChain) + byChainTestnetEndpoints + sum(byChainUnclassified) = totalEndpoints. l1Rates puts delivered over three denominators side by side: deliveredOfAttemptsPct is l1.delivered / l1.attempts, whose denominator includes the held attempts (l1.inconclusive) and the attempts still awaiting on-chain re-read (l1.awaitingReread). deliveredOfNotHeldPct is l1.delivered / (l1.attempts - l1.inconclusive), whose denominator still includes the awaiting rows. deliveredOfFinalOutcomePct is l1.delivered / (l1.attempts - l1.inconclusive - l1.awaitingReread), the share of attempts with a counted, final outcome that delivered. Percentages have one decimal and are null when the denominator is 0. l1.awaitingReread counts rows at settle_claimed (the seller asserted a settlement and vet402 has not yet re-read it on-chain, and the daily re-read runs at 14:00 UTC). l1.awaitingRereadOlderThan1d and l1.awaitingRereadOlderThan7d count those whose attempt is more than 1 and 7 days old, and l1.awaitingRereadOldestAttemptAt is the oldest one. A row stays there while the chain read cannot settle it either way (for example a transaction the RPC does not return yet), so a few rows wait far longer than a day. withdrawnFail counts endpoints with catalog status delisted whose newest probes would publish as fail. Those endpoints are left out of publishedFail. A pass on a delisted endpoint stays in publishedPass. catalogSnapshots also lists the PayAI facilitator discovery and the Rail402 discovery, counted for comparison. Their listings are outside the measured population (no L0 check, no purchase). A source whose read failed shows status fetch_failed with null counts in place of 0. catalogSourcesNotRead lists catalogs vet402 does not read, with the reason.

erc8004.about: Exact lowercase address equality between the payTo of vet402 purchase rows and the owner or agentWallet of an agent in vet402's index of the ERC-8004 Identity Registry. The top-level counts are Base. byChain gives Base, Ethereum and BNB Chain each on its own, with the agents scanned, the agents matched and the block the index has read to. A chain whose index cannot be read says unavailable with a reason and carries no counts. Each purchase row counts once even when its payTo owns several agents. readAt is when these counts were read from the database, cached up to 5 minutes.

settlementIndex.about: lastReadAt is when vet402's own settlements index last saved its read position for that chain. settlements30d counts settlements that index found in the last 30 days (source chain_index, by block time). The index reads transfers to payTo addresses listed in the catalogs vet402 reads, so the count leaves out other x402 settlements on that chain. A chain with status never_read has no saved read position and carries no read time. readAt is when these figures were read from the database, cached up to 1 hour.
